command_result.command: cd /app; find . -path ./data -prune -o -type f -print | head -100; ls -la data; cat docs/overview.md; wc -c docs/*
cd /app/docs; cat lending.md exports.md loans.md fees.md output.md changelog.md

cd /app/docs; sed -n 25,200p loans.md; cd ..; cat tests/test_fees.py; cat tools/check_fees.py | head -60; cat data/policy.ini data/branches.csv data/calendar.csv; ls data/exports; head -5 data/patrons.csv data/waivers.csv

cd /app/data/exports; cat manifest.txt | head; for f in cen-2027-01-16.csv har-2027-01-11.jsonl resend-cen.csv; do head -4 $f; done; head -c 3 cen-2027-02-07.csv | xxd; cat ../../tests/fixtures/exports/input/exports/manifest.txt; cut -d, -f3,4,5 ../waivers.csv | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -5; awk -F, '{print $4" "$5}' ../waivers.csv | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head -20; grep -c . ../patrons.csv
cd /app; mkdir -p out; python3 bin/fees.py data out/statements.json; echo $?; python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . 2>&1 | tail -15; python tools/check_fees.py

cd /app; echo '{"status": "success", "summary": "Wrote /app/bin/fees.py following the documented rules and ran it on /app/data to produce /app/out/statements.json. The unit tests pass and check_fees.py reports all 228 statements and 4 branch rows matching."}' > STATUS.json; cat STATUS.json
